title: finding(plugin-map/plugin-gantt): the registrations do not declare `data` / `staticData` as inputs, so validateTree warns unknown-prop on a staticData-only block the schema accepts — the objectui#7712 shape
body:
Filing gate: class (b), a declared contract that the implementation contradicts. Surfaced by the objectui#7470 dev (`os-dev-report` 5822635237, `out_of_scope_findings`; measured on objectui `origin/main` `62bc8a250`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`. ⛔ Unlabelled: `domain:*`, type and priority belong to triage. Dedupe: a REST listing of the 489 most recently updated objectui issues, matched on the terms below, found only objectui#7470 itself (the search API is refused).

## What (relayed from the dev; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

`ObjectMapSchema` and `ObjectGanttSchema` declare `data` and `staticData` (two of the three record sources that `requireRecordSource` accepts). The `object-map`, `map` and `object-gantt` registrations do not list them in `inputs`, so `sdui-parser` `validateTree` reports a staticData-only block as **unknown-prop** (a warning), which is the objectui#7712 shape. The objectui#7470 ruling (`5809231477`) only dropped `required` from `objectName`; it did not order declaring these, so they were left out of PR objectui#10390.

`Seam: spec:ObjectMapSchema.staticData / ObjectGanttSchema.staticData → renderer:object-map / map / object-gantt registration inputs`

Dedupe words: object-map staticData unknown-prop · object-gantt data input undeclared · map registration staticData · record source inputs declared
